title: 2026 UK ETS non-significant monitoring change QA controls

sources.title: UK ETS for installations: how to comply

facts.fact: Non-significant monitoring-plan changes must be notified to the regulator by 31 December in the year of the change.
A change to a default calculation factor can be non-significant where the value is included in the monitoring plan.
Replacing a meter without affecting the tier can be non-significant.
Changing procedure details with no effect on data accuracy can be non-significant.
Non-significant changes are notified through METS.
The notification must describe the change.
The operator must set out how the change affects monitoring-plan information where appropriate.
The operator must explain how the change is in accordance with the MRR.
Temporary monitoring-method changes have a separate 14-day notification rule or as soon as reasonably practicable.
Measurement-equipment outage and tier-threshold corrective-action events are separate regulator-notification cases.

guard_patterns.rule: Keep non-significant changes distinct from permit variations.
Do not substitute the temporary-change notification rule.
Preserve no-tier-impact condition for meter replacement.
Preserve no-accuracy-effect condition for procedure changes.
